from AlgorithmImports import *

class EquityOpenInterestAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE).symbol
        self._previous_day_close = None

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._spy),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy, 1),
            self._trade
        )

    def _trade(self) -> None:
        if not self._previous_day_close:
            return

        open_interest = self.securities[self._spy].open_interest

        if open_interest > self._previous_day_close:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, 1.0)
        elif open_interest < self._previous_day_close:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, -1.0)
        else:
            self.liquidate(self._spy)

        self._previous_day_close = self.securities[self._spy].close
